sentences.text: The occurrence of the accident on 25.08.2015 is not in dispute.
The fact that a 45 year old who was travelling in the vehicle in question was killed, is also not in dispute.
3. The insurer, is however in appeal, contending that the deceased Mahalinga @ Mahalingaiah was an unauthorised passenger in the offending vehicle and therefore the insurer would not be liable.

4. The claimants, on the other hand, are in appeal contending that Mahalinga was working as a loader-cum- cleaner and therefore, the insurer would be liable to pay the compensation in view of the fact that there was, admittedly, a policy of insurance issued in respect of the said vehicle.

5. The Tribunal has recorded a finding that Mahalinga was travelling in the Goods Tempo by loading tender coconuts and this finding is based on the Charge-sheet that had been filed and the spot mahazar.
6. The owner of the offending vehicle, who was arrayed as respondent No.2, did not enter appearance and did not deny the allegations of the claimants that the deceased was a loader-cum-cleaner.
7. In the light of these indisputable facts, the finding recorded by the Tribunal that Mahalinga was not a gratuitous passenger but a loader-cum-cleaner cannot be found fault with.
Consequently, the appeal of the insurer is dismissed.
8. As regards the compensation is concerned, the Tribunal has assessed the notional income of the deceased at Rs.7,000/- per month.
Since, the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority has fixed a sum of Rs.9,000/- as notional income for the accidents of the year 2015, the said income will have to be applied.

9. As per the decision of the Apex Court in the case of National Insurance Company Limited vs.
Pranay Sethi and Others - (2017) 16 SCC 680, as the deceased was aged about 45 years, 25% of the same (Rs.2,250/-) is required to be added to the said income as future prospects and the resultant income would be Rs.11,250/-.

a multiplier of '14' would have to be applied.

16. The apportionment, deposit and release of the enhanced compensation amount shall be made as per the ratio adopted by the Tribunal.
